simple.meaning: נָהַל (nâhal) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Genesis 33:14. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, flock, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָהַל (H5095) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָהַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: נָהַל (nâhal) / H5095 is tracked through Genesis 33:14, Genesis 47:17, Exodus 15:13, 2 Chronicles 28:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H5095. nahal [ נָהַל ] verb Pi`el lead, guide to a watering-place or station, and cause to rest there; bring to a station or place of rest; lead, guide; refresh (compare Arabic watering-place, take a first drink; likewise (Dozy) station, stage of the road; perhaps also Assyrian Nâlu , lie down Dl HWB 438 ; Dl HA 5f.; Prol. 17 ff. tries to explain all the passages from this Assyrian nâlu; against him see Prä LOPh i. 195 Che Acad., April 12, 1884 DHM ZKF i. 357 f. Nö ZMG xi. 1886, 728 ; two √ √ proposed by RDWilson Presb. Rev. (N.Y.), April, 1885 (careful article), compare T. Che Psa 23:2 . critical note .); — Pi`el Perfect 2masculine singular נֵהַלָתָּ Exod 15:13 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְנַהֵל Isa 40:11 ; suffix יְנַהֲלֵנִי Psa 23:2 , יְנַהְלֵם Isa 49:10 ; וַיְנַהֲלֵם Gen 47:17 ; 2Chr 32:22 ; 2 masculine singular suffix תְּנַהֲלֵנִי Psa 31:4 ; 3 masculine plural suffix וַיְנַהֲלוּם 2Chr 28:15 ; Participle מְנַהֵל Isa 51:18 ; — 1 lead to watering-place (or station), and cause to rest there , subject ׳י as shepherd, Isa 49:10 ( עַלֿ location; || נהג ), Psa 23:2 (with עַלֿ location; || הִרְבִּיץ ), Isa 40:11 (|| קִבֵּץ רעה, ). 2 lead or bring to a station, a goal , ׳י subject Exod 15:13 (song; no object expressed, אֶלֿ location; || נחה ); human subject 2Chr 28:15 and they conducted all the feeble of them by means of ( ב ) asses (|| הֵבִיא ). 3 lead, guide: figurative, לָהּ מְנַהֵל אֵין Isa 51:18 there is no one to be a guide for her , i.e. for Jerusalem, drunk with cup of ׳י s fury (|| בְּיָדָהּ מַחֲזִיק ); ׳י subject Psa 31:4 lead me (|| תַּנְחֵנִי ). 4. give rest to (?) ׳וַיְנ מִסָּבִיב 2Chr 32:22 and he gave them rest on every hand , compare ᵑ9 ᵐ5 (= מִסּ לָהֶם ׳וַיָּנִח 1 Chronicles 2, 18 +, probably so read here, see Be DHM Öttli). 5 refresh with food, בַּלֶּחֶם ׳וַיְנ Gen 47:17 (J). Hithpa`el Imperfect probably journey by stations, stages , only 1 singular אֶתְנַהֲלָה Gen 33:14 (J), I will proceed, journey on, by stages (i.e. deliberately with family and cattle). נַהֲלָל see II. נַהֲלֹל . below
